name: Amos
description: A prophet from Judah sent to warn Israel before its fall.
intro: A prophet from Judah sent to warn Israel before its fall.

timeline.kings: Jeroboam II of Israel, Uzziah of Judah

whereFits: Amos belongs in the 2 Kings story, after the kingdom has split and before Israel falls to Assyria. It fits near 2 Kings 14–15 and points ahead to 2 Kings 17.
